chapterInfo.content:
9
Ɔsoro ne asase so kronkronbea
1Na afei, kane apam no nso wɔ ɔsom ho nhyehyɛɛ ne wiase ha kronkronbea deɛ: 2#Eks 25.23; 25.30-31 Ɛfiri sɛ, wɔsii ntomadan bi a wɔkɔ mu kane a kaneadua ne ɛpono ne paanoo a ɛgu soɔ wɔ mu a wɔfrɛ hɔ kronkronbea. 3#Eks 26.33 Na ntwamutam a ɛtɔ so mmienu no mu wɔ ntomadan a wɔfrɛ hɔ kronkron mu kronkron. 4#Eks 16.33; Num 17.8-10; Eks 25.16; 25.21 Ɛwɔ sika aduhwamhyeɛ bukyia ne apam adaka a wɔde sika adura ho nyinaa, a sika pɔre a mana wɔ mu, ne Aaron poma a ɛfefɛeɛ ne apam aboɔpono no wɔ mu. 5#Eks 25.18; 26.34 Na ɛso na animuonyam Kerubim a ɛtrɛ mpata adwa no soɔ sie; nso yɛrentumi nka nnoɔma yi ho nsɛm mmaako mmaako seesei.
6 # Num 18.3-4 Na wɔsiesiee nnoɔma yi saa a, asɔfoɔ no kɔ ntomadan a wɔsi mu kane no mu daa kɔyɛ ɔsom ho nnwuma. 7#Lew 16.2; 16.14-15 Na deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu no deɛ, ɔsɔfo panin nko na afe biara ɔkɔ hɔ prɛko, ɔde mogya a ɔno ara, ne ɔman no mfomsoɔ nti ɔde kɔma. 8#Heb 10.19 Emu na Honhom Kronkron kyerɛ yei pefee sɛ, ɛberɛ a wɔnnya nyii kwan a ɛde kɔ kronkron mu no adi nkyerɛeɛ no, na ntomadan a ɛdi kan no da so si hɔ. 9#Heb 10.1-2 Na ɛno yɛ mfatoho de ma seesei berɛ yi, sɛdeɛ wɔde ayɛyɛdeɛ nso ma, ɛne afɔdeɛ a ɛntumi mma deɛ ɔsom no nni mu n’ahonim fam, 10#Lew 11.2; 15.18; Num 19.13 na ɛne nnuane ne anonneɛ ne adware ahodoɔ yɛ honam nsiesieeɛ nko a ɛda hɔ sɛ wɔnyɛ nkɔduru berɛ a wɔahyɛ ato hɔ no.
Kristo asɔfodie a ɛdi mu
11 # Heb 10.1; 6.20 Nanso Kristo a ɔbaa sɛ nnepa a aba dada no ho sɔfo panin, nam ntomadan a ɛso na ɛyɛ pɛ kyɛne soɔ, (a wɔamfa nsa ansie, ɛne sɛ, ɛmfiri adebɔ yi mu mu), 12nso ɛnyɛ mmirekyie ne anantwie mma mogya, na mmom ɔno ara ne mogya so na ɔnam kɔɔ kronkronbea hɔ prɛko kɔnyaa daa ɔgyeɛ. 13#Lew 16.14-15; Num 19.9 Na sɛ mmirekyie ne anantwinini mogya ne nantwibereɛ nso a wɔde dwira wɔn a wɔn ho agu fi, te wɔn ho kɔ honam ahofire mu a, 14#1 Pe 1.18-19; 1 Yoh 1.7; Adi 1.5 mprɛ ahe ara na Kristo a ɔnam daa honhom so de ne ho bɔɔ afɔdeɛ, a ɛho nni dɛm maa Onyankopɔn no mogya rente mo ahonim ho mfiri nnwuma funu mu nkɔsom Onyankopɔn a ɔte aseɛ?
Kristo yɛ Apam foforɔ ntamgyinafoɔ
15 # Heb 12.24; 1 Ti 2.5 Yei nti na ɔyɛ Apam foforɔ ntamgyinafoɔ, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na wɔn a wɔabɔ wɔn din afrɛ wɔn no anya daa agyapadeɛ bɔhyɛ no, ɛsiane owuo a ɔwu de gyee wɔn a wɔyɛɛ kane apam no ho mfomsoɔ no. 16Na deɛ samanseɛ wɔ no, ɛhɔ na ɛtwa sɛ wɔkyerɛ sɛ, deɛ ɔhyɛeɛ no awu, 17na samanseɛ tim wɔ awufoɔ so, na deɛ ɔhyɛeɛ no te ase a, anka emu nyɛ den da. 18Ɛno nti na wɔankwati mogya anhyɛ kane apam no nso aseɛ. 19Na Mose kaa ahyɛdeɛ biara kyerɛɛ ɔman mu no nyinaa, sɛdeɛ mmara no teɛ wieeɛ no, ɔfaa anantwie mma ne mmirekyie mogya ne nsuo ne kuntu kɔkɔɔ ne sommɛ na ɔde petee nwoma no ara ne ɔman no nyinaa so 20#Eks 24.6-8 kaa sɛ: Yei ne apam a Onyankopɔn ahyɛ wɔ mo ho no mogya. 21#Lew 8.15; 8.19 Na ntomadan ne asɔfodwuma nnoɔma nyinaa nso, ɔde mogya no petee ho saa ara. 22#Lew 17.11; Efe 1.7 Ampa ara, wɔde mogya na ɛte nnoɔma nyinaa ho, sɛdeɛ mmara no teɛ, na mogya angu a, bɔne fakyɛ nni hɔ.
Kristo afɔreɛ prɛko a ɔbɔeɛ
23 # Heb 8.5 Ɛnneɛ na ɛtwa sɛ wɔde yeinom te ɔsoro nnoɔma nhwɛsoɔ no ho. Na ɔsoro nnoɔma no ankasa deɛ, wɔde afɔdeɛ a ɛyɛ kyɛne yeinom na ɛtee ho. 24#Heb 9.11-12; 1 Yoh 2.1 Na Kristo anhyɛne kronkronbea a wɔde nsa yɛeɛ, a ɛyɛ kronkronbea pa ara no ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ no mu, na mmom ɔhyɛnee ɔsoro ankasa sɛ afei ɔrekɔyi ne ho adi Nyankopɔn anim ama yɛn. 25Nanso wanhyɛne hɔ sɛ ɔde ne ho bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ mprɛ pii, sɛdeɛ ɔsɔfo panin de obi mogya hyɛne kronkronbea daa mfirinhyia no; 26#1 Ko 10.11; Gal 4.4; Heb 9.12 ɛnneɛ anka ɛsɛ no sɛ ɔtaa hunu amane firi wiase fapem, na afei a wiase mmerɛ rewie duro yi, wayi ne ho adi prɛko sɛ ɔnam afɔdeɛ a ɔde ne ho bɔeɛ so bɛyi bɔne. 27#Gye 3.19 Na sɛdeɛ ɛda hɔ ma nnipa sɛ wɔbɛwu prɛko na ɛno akyi atemmuo bɛba no, 28#Heb 10.10; 10.12; 10.14 saa ara nso na Kristo a wɔde no bɔɔ afɔdeɛ prɛko sɛ ɔnsoa nnipa bebree bɔne no bɛkwati bɔne ayi ne ho adi ne mprenu soɔ, akyerɛ wɔn a wɔhwɛ no kwan no, de wɔn akɔ nkwagyeɛ mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na afei, kane apam no nso wɔ ɔsom ho nhyehyɛɛ ne wiase ha kronkronbea deɛ: Ɛfiri sɛ, wɔsii ntomadan bi a wɔkɔ mu kane a kaneadua ne ɛpono ne paanoo a ɛgu soɔ wɔ mu a wɔfrɛ hɔ kronkronbea. Na ntwamutam a ɛtɔ so mmienu no mu wɔ ntomadan a wɔfrɛ hɔ kronkron mu kronkron. Ɛwɔ sika aduhwamhyeɛ bukyia ne apam adaka a wɔde sika adura ho nyinaa, a sika pɔre a mana wɔ mu, ne Aaron poma a ɛfefɛeɛ ne apam aboɔpono no wɔ mu. Na ɛso na animuonyam Kerubim a ɛtrɛ mpata adwa no soɔ sie; nso yɛrentumi nka nnoɔma yi ho nsɛm mmaako mmaako seesei.
Na wɔsiesiee nnoɔma yi saa a, asɔfoɔ no kɔ ntomadan a wɔsi mu kane no mu daa kɔyɛ ɔsom ho nnwuma. Na deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu no deɛ, ɔsɔfo panin nko na afe biara ɔkɔ hɔ prɛko, ɔde mogya a ɔno ara, ne ɔman no mfomsoɔ nti ɔde kɔma. Emu na Honhom Kronkron kyerɛ yei pefee sɛ, ɛberɛ a wɔnnya nyii kwan a ɛde kɔ kronkron mu no adi nkyerɛeɛ no, na ntomadan a ɛdi kan no da so si hɔ. Na ɛno yɛ mfatoho de ma seesei berɛ yi, sɛdeɛ wɔde ayɛyɛdeɛ nso ma, ɛne afɔdeɛ a ɛntumi mma deɛ ɔsom no nni mu n’ahonim fam, na ɛne nnuane ne anonneɛ ne adware ahodoɔ yɛ honam nsiesieeɛ nko a ɛda hɔ sɛ wɔnyɛ nkɔduru berɛ a wɔahyɛ ato hɔ no.

Nanso Kristo a ɔbaa sɛ nnepa a aba dada no ho sɔfo panin, nam ntomadan a ɛso na ɛyɛ pɛ kyɛne soɔ, (a wɔamfa nsa ansie, ɛne sɛ, ɛmfiri adebɔ yi mu mu), nso ɛnyɛ mmirekyie ne anantwie mma mogya, na mmom ɔno ara ne mogya so na ɔnam kɔɔ kronkronbea hɔ prɛko kɔnyaa daa ɔgyeɛ. Na sɛ mmirekyie ne anantwinini mogya ne nantwibereɛ nso a wɔde dwira wɔn a wɔn ho agu fi, te wɔn ho kɔ honam ahofire mu a, mprɛ ahe ara na Kristo a ɔnam daa honhom so de ne ho bɔɔ afɔdeɛ, a ɛho nni dɛm maa Onyankopɔn no mogya rente mo ahonim ho mfiri nnwuma funu mu nkɔsom Onyankopɔn a ɔte aseɛ?

Yei nti na ɔyɛ Apam foforɔ ntamgyinafoɔ, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na wɔn a wɔabɔ wɔn din afrɛ wɔn no anya daa agyapadeɛ bɔhyɛ no, ɛsiane owuo a ɔwu de gyee wɔn a wɔyɛɛ kane apam no ho mfomsoɔ no. Na deɛ samanseɛ wɔ no, ɛhɔ na ɛtwa sɛ wɔkyerɛ sɛ, deɛ ɔhyɛeɛ no awu, na samanseɛ tim wɔ awufoɔ so, na deɛ ɔhyɛeɛ no te ase a, anka emu nyɛ den da. Ɛno nti na wɔankwati mogya anhyɛ kane apam no nso aseɛ. Na Mose kaa ahyɛdeɛ biara kyerɛɛ ɔman mu no nyinaa, sɛdeɛ mmara no teɛ wieeɛ no, ɔfaa anantwie mma ne mmirekyie mogya ne nsuo ne kuntu kɔkɔɔ ne sommɛ na ɔde petee nwoma no ara ne ɔman no nyinaa so kaa sɛ: Yei ne apam a Onyankopɔn ahyɛ wɔ mo ho no mogya. Na ntomadan ne asɔfodwuma nnoɔma nyinaa nso, ɔde mogya no petee ho saa ara. Ampa ara, wɔde mogya na ɛte nnoɔma nyinaa ho, sɛdeɛ mmara no teɛ, na mogya angu a, bɔne fakyɛ nni hɔ.

Ɛnneɛ na ɛtwa sɛ wɔde yeinom te ɔsoro nnoɔma nhwɛsoɔ no ho. Na ɔsoro nnoɔma no ankasa deɛ, wɔde afɔdeɛ a ɛyɛ kyɛne yeinom na ɛtee ho. Na Kristo anhyɛne kronkronbea a wɔde nsa yɛeɛ, a ɛyɛ kronkronbea pa ara no ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ no mu, na mmom ɔhyɛnee ɔsoro ankasa sɛ afei ɔrekɔyi ne ho adi Nyankopɔn anim ama yɛn. Nanso wanhyɛne hɔ sɛ ɔde ne ho bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ mprɛ pii, sɛdeɛ ɔsɔfo panin de obi mogya hyɛne kronkronbea daa mfirinhyia no; ɛnneɛ anka ɛsɛ no sɛ ɔtaa hunu amane firi wiase fapem, na afei a wiase mmerɛ rewie duro yi, wayi ne ho adi prɛko sɛ ɔnam afɔdeɛ a ɔde ne ho bɔeɛ so bɛyi bɔne. Na sɛdeɛ ɛda hɔ ma nnipa sɛ wɔbɛwu prɛko na ɛno akyi atemmuo bɛba no, saa ara nso na Kristo a wɔde no bɔɔ afɔdeɛ prɛko sɛ ɔnsoa nnipa bebree bɔne no bɛkwati bɔne ayi ne ho adi ne mprenu soɔ, akyerɛ wɔn a wɔhwɛ no kwan no, de wɔn akɔ nkwagyeɛ mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
